title: Ohang orqali ma’no berish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida tushuvchi, ko‘tariluvchi, tushib-ko‘tariluvchi va ko‘tarilib-tushuvchi ohanglarni farqlab, munosabatni (ishonch, ikkilanish, hayrat, norozilik) ohang bilan bildirasiz, qarama-qarshi urg‘u bilan ma’noni aniqlaysiz va qisqa dialogni to‘rt xil munosabatda ifodali o‘qiy olasiz.

scenes.title: Ohang orqali ma’no
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda taqdimot qilishni o‘rgandik: tuzilma, signpostlar, pauza va urg‘u. Bugun shu mavzuni chuqurlashtiramiz: ohang. Bir xil so‘zlar ohangga qarab samimiy, kinoyali yoki qo‘pol eshitilishi mumkin. Dars oxirida qisqa dialogni to‘rt xil munosabatda o‘qiy olasiz va ohang orqali o‘z fikringizni aniq yetkazasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we practised presentations. Today we focus on intonation: how the music of your voice changes what your words really mean.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar taqdimotni mashq qildik. Bugun ohangga e’tibor qaratamiz: ovozingiz kuyi so‘zlaringizning asl ma’nosini qanday o‘zgartirishini ko‘ramiz.

scenes.title: So‘z va kuy
board: Intonation = how you feel about it
scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilida so‘zlar xabarni, ohang esa sizning munosabatingizni beradi. Great so‘zini olaylik. Baland boshlanib, aniq tushsa, siz chindan xursandsiz. Past, tekis va qisqa aytilsa, ma’no teskari: zo‘r-ku, ya’ni yomon bo‘ldi. Tinglovchi ko‘pincha so‘zga emas, aynan ohangga ishonadi. Shuning uchun grammatikasi mukammal gap ham noto‘g‘ri ohang bilan qo‘pol eshitilishi mumkin.
scenes.say: Great! That's wonderful news. Oh, great. Now we've missed the bus.
scenes.say_uz: Zo‘r! Bu ajoyib yangilik. Voy, zo‘r. Endi avtobusdan qolib ketdik.

scenes.title: Birinchi nuqta: ohang bo‘lagi va yadro
board: Tone unit: | I'll call you TOmorrow |
The tone starts on the nucleus: ↘ ↗ ↘↗ ↗↘
scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: munosabat uchun ohang. Avval ikkita atama. Nutq ohang bo‘laklariga, tone unitlarga bo‘linadi. Har bo‘lakda bitta eng kuchli urg‘uli bo‘g‘in bor, uni nucleus, ya’ni yadro deymiz. Odatda bu oxirgi mazmunli so‘zning urg‘uli bo‘g‘ini: I’ll call you to-MOR-row. Ohangning asosiy harakati, tushish yoki ko‘tarilish, aynan shu yadrodan boshlanadi. Ingliz tilida to‘rtta asosiy ohangni ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: I'll call you tomorrow. The main movement of the voice begins on the stressed syllable of tomorrow.
scenes.say_uz: Ertaga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Ovozning asosiy harakati tomorrow so‘zining urg‘uli bo‘g‘inidan boshlanadi.

scenes.title: Tushuvchi ohang ↘
board: Wh-questions: Where do you ↘live? · Commands: Sit ↘down.
scenes.say_native: Tushuvchi ohang eng ko‘p uchraydi. U tugallanganlik va ishonchni bildiradi: men aniq bilaman, gap tugadi. Oddiy darak gaplar, wh bilan boshlanadigan savollar va buyruqlar odatda tushuvchi ohangda aytiladi: where do you live, sit down. Agar darak gapni tushirmasangiz, tinglovchi gapingiz tugamaganini yoki siz ishonchsiz ekaningizni his qiladi.
scenes.say: I've finished the report. What time does the meeting start? Please sit down.
scenes.say_uz: Hisobotni tugatdim. Yig‘ilish soat nechada boshlanadi? Iltimos, o‘tiring.

scenes.title: Ko‘tariluvchi ohang ↗
scenes.say_native: Ko‘tariluvchi ohang ochiq, tugallanmagan ma’no beradi. U ha yoki yo‘q savollarida ko‘p uchraydi: are you coming with us. Eng qiziq jihati: ingliz tilida darak gapni faqat ohang bilan savolga aylantirish mumkin: you’re leaving already, ko‘tarilish bilan. Bu ko‘pincha hayrat yoki tekshirishni bildiradi. Ko‘tarilish muloyimlik va qiziqishni ham ko‘rsatadi, masalan suhbatdoshni gapirishga undaganda.
scenes.say: Are you coming with us? You're leaving already? Really? Tell me more.
scenes.say_uz: Biz bilan borasizmi? Shu zahoti ketyapsizmi? Rostdanmi? Batafsilroq gapiring.

scenes.title: Bir so‘z, ikki ma’no
scenes.say_native: Bitta so‘z ohangga qarab ikki xil ishlatiladi. Sorry ko‘tariluvchi ohangda, ya’ni sorry, savol: qaytaring, eshitmadim. Tushuvchi ohangda esa haqiqiy uzr: sorry, mening aybim. Really ham shunday: ko‘tarilsa, rostdanmi, hayratdaman; tushsa, rostdan shunday, ishoning. O‘zbekchada bu farqni kechirasizmi va kechirasiz kabi qo‘shimcha bilan berish mumkin, inglizchada esa faqat ohang ishlaydi.
scenes.say: Sorry? I didn't catch that. Sorry. It was my fault. Really? I had no idea. It really was the best day of my life.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz? Eshitmay qoldim. Kechirasiz, mening aybim. Rostdanmi? Bilmagan ekanman. Bu chindan hayotimning eng yaxshi kuni edi.

scenes.title: Tushib-ko‘tariluvchi ohang ↘↗
board: The food was ↘↗good… (but the service wasn't)
scenes.say_native: Tushib-ko‘tariluvchi ohang, fall-rise, C1 darajasida eng muhim ohanglardan biri. U aytilmagan lekin ni bildiradi. The food was good, fall-rise bilan aytsangiz, tinglovchi davomini kutadi: lekin xizmat yomon edi. I might come esa va’da bermayman degani. Bu ohang muloyim e’tiroz uchun ham qulay: yes, but, ya’ni to‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri yo‘q demasdan ikkilanishni bildirasiz.
scenes.say: The food was good... but the service was terribly slow. Well, I might come, but I can't promise anything.
scenes.say_uz: Ovqat yaxshi edi... lekin xizmat juda sekin edi. Xo‘sh, balki kelarman, lekin hech narsa va’da qilolmayman.

scenes.title: Ko‘tarilib-tushuvchi ohang ↗↘
scenes.say_native: Ko‘tarilib-tushuvchi ohang, rise-fall, kuchli his-tuyg‘uni bildiradi. Ovoz avval ko‘tariladi, keyin keskin tushadi. U hayrat va zavqni ifodalaydi: oh, that’s lovely. Lekin xuddi shu ohang hamma narsa ayon degan ma’noni ham berishi mumkin: of course he forgot, ya’ni u doim shunday qiladi-ku. Qaysi biri ekanini kontekst va yuz ifodasi hal qiladi. Bu ohangni ortiqcha ishlatmang, u juda emotsional.
scenes.say: Oh, that's lovely! What a beautiful garden. Of course he forgot. He always does.
scenes.say_uz: Voy, qanday ajoyib! Qanday chiroyli bog‘. Albatta, u esdan chiqargan. U doim shunday qiladi.

scenes.title: O‘zbek tili bilan solishtirish
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida munosabatni ko‘pincha yuklamalar beradi: -mi savol, -ku ayonlik yoki hayrat, -chi qarshi savol, -da tasdiq. Keldi-ku deganda -ku hammasini aytadi. Ingliz tilida bunday yuklamalar deyarli yo‘q, ularning vazifasini ohang bajaradi. Shuning uchun o‘zbek tilida so‘zlashuvchilar inglizchada tekis gapirsa, munosabat yo‘qolib qoladi va nutq quruq, ba’zan qo‘pol eshitiladi.
scenes.say: He came! And you? Well, it's obvious, isn't it?
scenes.say_uz: Keldi-ku! Sen-chi? Xo‘sh, bu ayon-ku, shundaymi?

scenes.title: Ohangdagi tipik xatolar
board: ✗ Thank you. (flat, low) → sounds bored or rude
✗ rising on every statement → sounds unsure
scenes.say_native: Ikkita tipik xato. Birinchisi, tekis, past ohang. Thank you yoki that’s fine past va tekis aytilsa, inglizcha quloqqa zerikkan yoki norozi bo‘lib eshitiladi. Samimiy rahmat baland boshlanadi va aniq tushadi. Ikkinchisi, har bir darak gapni ko‘tarish. Bunda har gap savolga o‘xshaydi va siz o‘zingizga ishonmaydigandek ko‘rinasiz. Darak gapda ishonch bilan tushiring.
scenes.say: Thank you. That's very kind of you. My name is Dilnoza, and I work in sales.
scenes.say_uz: Rahmat. Bu juda mehribonlik. Mening ismim Dilnoza, savdo bo‘limida ishlayman.

scenes.title: Munosabatni aniqlang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Doskada to‘rtta gap, har birida ohang belgisi bor. Har biri qanday munosabatni bildirishini ayting: ishonch, hayrat yoki tekshirish, ikkilanish va lekin, yoki kuchli his. Keyin har bir gapni o‘zingiz shu ohang bilan baland ovozda ayting. Ovoz chiqarib aytganda strelkaga qat’iy amal qiling.
scenes.say: Look at the arrows on the board. What attitude does each sentence express? Then say each one aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Doskadagi strelkalarga qarang. Har bir gap qanday munosabatni bildiradi? Keyin har birini baland ovozda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: fall-rise, ikkilanish. Mehmonxona toza edi, lekin boshqa narsa yaxshi emas, masalan joylashuvi. Ikkinchi: ko‘tariluvchi ohang, darak gap savolga aylangan: tugatdingizmi, shuncha tez? Hayrat yoki tekshirish. Uchinchi: rise-fall, kuchli zavq. To‘rtinchi: tushuvchi ohang, aniq va’da, oltida albatta bo‘laman.
scenes.say: The hotel was clean... but the location was awful. You've finished? Already? Wonderful! I'll be there at six.
scenes.say_uz: Mehmonxona toza edi... lekin joylashuvi dahshat edi. Tugatdingizmi? Shu zahoti? Ajoyib! Soat oltida u yerda bo‘laman.

scenes.title: So‘roq qo‘shimchalar: ↘ yoki ↗
board: It's cold, ↘isn't it? = I expect you to agree
You've met her, ↗haven't you? = I'm not sure
Falling tag = comment · Rising tag = real question

examples.t: It's a lovely day, isn't it?

scenes.say_native: Question taglarda ohang ma’noni butunlay o‘zgartiradi. Tag tushsa, siz javobni bilasiz va faqat rozilik kutasiz: it’s a lovely day, isn’t it. Bu ko‘pincha suhbatni boshlash usuli. Tag ko‘tarilsa, siz chindan ishonchingiz komil emas va javob so‘rayapsiz: you’ve met Sarah, haven’t you. O‘zbekchadagi shunday emasmi yoki to‘g‘rimi ham ikki xil aytilishi mumkin, lekin inglizchada bu farq ancha muntazam.
scenes.say: It's a lovely day, isn't it? You've met Sarah, haven't you? I'm not quite sure.
scenes.say_uz: Ajoyib kun, shunday emasmi? Sara bilan tanishgansiz, to‘g‘rimi? Unchalik ishonchim yo‘q.

scenes.title: Tag ohangini tanlang
board: 1) Small talk at a bus stop: It's freezing today, isn't it?
2) You think the shop closes at six: The shop closes at six, doesn't it?
3) Your friend clearly loved the film: You enjoyed that, didn't you?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta vaziyat. Har birida tag tushadimi yoki ko‘tariladimi, aniqlang va gapni o‘sha ohangda ayting. Savol beruvchi javobni biladimi yoki chindan so‘rayaptimi, shuni o‘ylang. Ikkinchi gapda bu odam faqat taxmin qilyapti, bunga e’tibor bering. Ikki-uch marta takrorlang, farq aniq eshitilsin.
scenes.say: Decide whether each tag falls or rises, then say the sentence aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir tag tushadimi yoki ko‘tariladimi, aniqlang va gapni baland ovozda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: tushuvchi tag, chunki bu kichik suhbat, ikkalangiz ham sovuqligini bilasiz. Ikkinchi: ko‘tariluvchi tag, chunki siz faqat taxmin qilyapsiz va javob kerak. Uchinchi: tushuvchi tag, do‘stingiz filmni yoqtirgani aniq ko‘rinib turibdi, siz faqat tasdiq kutasiz. Qoida oddiy: bilasiz, tushiring; bilmaysiz, ko‘taring.
scenes.say: It's freezing today, isn't it? The shop closes at six, doesn't it? You enjoyed that, didn't you?
scenes.say_uz: Bugun juda sovuq, shunday emasmi? Do‘kon oltida yopiladi, to‘g‘rimi? Sizga yoqdi, shunday emasmi?

scenes.title: Tinglash: ikki ijarachi
board: Listen for surprise, reservation and irony
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi dialogni tinglang. Bir uyda yashaydigan ikki do‘st, Kate va Ben, shanba kuni haqida gaplashmoqda. Har bir javobda qanday munosabat borligiga e’tibor bering: hayrat, ikkilanish, kinoya. Ohang bilan birga so‘zlar ham sizga yordam beradi. Keyin uchta savolga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Kate: I've invited my parents for dinner on Saturday. Ben: This Saturday? Kate: Yes. Is that a problem? Ben: Well... I'd sort of planned to have friends over. Kate: You could all join us! Ben: Oh, wonderful. Six friends and your parents in one tiny kitchen. Kate: Fine, I'll book a restaurant instead. Ben: Now that's a brilliant idea!
scenes.say_uz: Kate: Shanba kuni ota-onamni kechki ovqatga taklif qildim. Ben: Shu shanbadami? Kate: Ha. Muammo bormi? Ben: Xo‘sh... men do‘stlarimni chaqirishni rejalashtirgandim. Kate: Hammangiz qo‘shilishingiz mumkin! Ben: Voy, ajoyib. Olti do‘st va ota-onang bitta kichkina oshxonada. Kate: Mayli, o‘rniga restoran band qilaman. Ben: Mana bu zo‘r g‘oya!

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: Ben this Saturday deganda qanday munosabat bildiradi? Ikkinchi: oh, wonderful samimiymi? Nega yo‘q, qaysi so‘zlar buni ko‘rsatadi? Uchinchi: qaysi gapda Ben chindan xursand? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan bering. Dialogni ikkinchi marta tinglasangiz, yanada ko‘p narsani sezasiz.
scenes.say: One. What does Ben's question, this Saturday, show? Two. Is oh, wonderful sincere? Three. Which line is genuinely enthusiastic?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Benning shu shanbadami degan savoli nimani ko‘rsatadi? Ikki. Voy, ajoyib samimiymi? Uch. Qaysi gap chindan zavqli?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) No: ironic; 'tiny kitchen' shows the problem
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: this Saturday ko‘tariluvchi ohangda, hayrat va biroz xavotir. Keyingi well esa fall-rise bilan, ya’ni lekin bor. Ikkinchi: oh, wonderful kinoya, samimiy emas, chunki keyin bitta kichkina oshxona deydi. Uchinchi: now that’s a brilliant idea, bu yerda Ben chindan xursand. Now so‘zi va kuchli urg‘u samimiyatni oshiradi.
scenes.say: This Saturday shows surprise. Oh, wonderful is ironic: the tiny kitchen is the problem. Now that's a brilliant idea is sincere.
scenes.say_uz: Shu shanbadami hayratni ko‘rsatadi. Voy, ajoyib kinoya: muammo kichkina oshxonada. Mana bu zo‘r g‘oya esa samimiy.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi nuqta: qarama-qarshi urg‘u
board: Default: nucleus on the last content word
Contrast moves it: I bought a ↘NEW car (not a used one).

examples.t: I bought a NEW car, not a second-hand one.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: contrastive stress, qarama-qarshi urg‘u. Odatda yadro oxirgi mazmunli so‘zga tushadi: I bought a new CAR. Lekin biror narsani boshqasiga qarama-qarshi qo‘ysangiz, urg‘u o‘sha so‘zga ko‘chadi: I bought a NEW car, ya’ni ishlatilgan emas. So‘z tartibi o‘zgarmaydi, faqat urg‘u joyi o‘zgaradi. Tinglovchi buni darhol taqqoslash deb tushunadi.
scenes.say: I bought a new car. I bought a new car, not a second-hand one.
scenes.say_uz: Yangi mashina oldim. Ishlatilganini emas, yangi mashina oldim.

scenes.title: Bitta gap, to‘rt ma’no
board: I didn't take your PEN. (I took something else)
I didn't take YOUR pen. (I took someone else's)
I DIDN'T take your pen. · I didn't TAKE your pen.
scenes.say_native: Mashhur misol: I didn’t take your pen. PEN ga urg‘u: ruchkani emas, boshqa narsani oldim. YOUR ga urg‘u: sizniki emas, boshqa odamnikini oldim. DIDN’T ga urg‘u: yo‘q, umuman olmadim, inkor kuchaydi. TAKE ga urg‘u: olmadim, faqat ishlatdim yoki qarab turdim. I ga urg‘u bersak: men emas, boshqa odam oldi. Ko‘rdingizmi, so‘zlar bir xil, lekin beshta turli xabar.
scenes.say: I didn't take your pen. I didn't take your pen. I didn't take your pen. I didn't take your pen.
scenes.say_uz: Men ruchkangizni olmadim. Bir xil gap, har safar urg‘u boshqa so‘zda.

scenes.title: Tuzatish va ma’lum ma’lumot
board: A: Is it on Tuesday? B: No, it's on ↘THURSday.
A: The red shirt? B: No, the ↘BLUE shirt.
scenes.say_native: Qarama-qarshi urg‘u ayniqsa tuzatishda kerak. A: is it on Tuesday? B: no, it’s on THURSday. Yana bir qoida: suhbatda allaqachon aytilgan, ya’ni ma’lum so‘z urg‘uni yo‘qotadi. A: did you buy the red shirt? B: no, the BLUE shirt. Shirt takrorlangan, shuning uchun u kuchsiz, urg‘u yangi ma’lumotga, blue ga tushadi. Bu qoida ingliz nutqining tabiiyligini ta’minlaydi.
scenes.say: Is the meeting on Tuesday? No, it's on Thursday. Did you buy the red shirt? No, I bought the blue shirt.
scenes.say_uz: Yig‘ilish seshanbadami? Yo‘q, payshanbada. Qizil ko‘ylakni oldingizmi? Yo‘q, ko‘k ko‘ylakni oldim.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha urg‘u va inglizcha urg‘u
board: Uzbek: word order + particles: Kitobni MEN oldim. · Aynan men oldim.
English: same order, stress moves: I took the book.
✗ It was exactly me who… → ✓ I took it.

examples.t: I took the book, not Anvar.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida e’tiborni ko‘pincha so‘z tartibi bilan beramiz: urg‘uli so‘zni fe’ldan oldinga qo‘yamiz, kitobni men oldim. Yoki aynan, faqat kabi so‘zlar qo‘shamiz. Ingliz tilida so‘z tartibi qat’iy, shuning uchun ovoz ishlaydi: I took the book, I ga kuchli urg‘u. Ko‘p o‘quvchilar exactly yoki namely qo‘shib, gapni og‘irlashtiradi. Ko‘pincha bitta to‘g‘ri urg‘u yetarli.
scenes.say: I took the book, not Anvar. You don't need extra words. Just stress the right one.
scenes.say_uz: Kitobni Anvar emas, men oldim. Qo‘shimcha so‘z shart emas. Faqat kerakli so‘zga urg‘u bering.

scenes.title: Urg‘udagi xatolar
board: ✗ No, the blue SHIRT. → ✓ No, the BLUE shirt.
✗ It's ON Thursday. → ✓ It's on THURSday.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi, takrorlangan so‘zga urg‘u berish: the blue SHIRT. Tinglovchi boshqa ko‘ylak emas, boshqa narsa haqida gap ketyapti deb o‘ylaydi. Ikkinchisi, predlog yoki artiklga urg‘u: it’s ON Thursday, bu yerda on kuchsiz bo‘lishi kerak. Uchinchisi, har so‘zga teng urg‘u berish. Bunda hech narsa ajralib turmaydi va tinglovchi asosiy fikrni topa olmaydi.
scenes.say: Not the blue SHIRT, but the BLUE shirt. Not it's ON Thursday, but it's on THURSday.
scenes.say_uz: The blue SHIRT emas, the BLUE shirt. It’s ON Thursday emas, it’s on THURSday.

scenes.title: Urg‘u bilan tuzating
board: 1) A: You live in Samarkand, don't you? (Bukhara)
2) A: Is it a black coffee? (white)
3) A: So Aziz wrote the report? (Malika)
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir gapga qavsdagi ma’lumot bilan tuzatish kiritib javob bering. Javobni no bilan boshlang va urg‘uni faqat yangi, tuzatilgan so‘zga qo‘ying. Takrorlangan so‘zlarni kuchsiz ayting. Masalan birinchi gapda siz Samarqandda emas, boshqa shaharda yashaysiz.
scenes.say: Correct each statement using the word in brackets. Put the stress only on the new information.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni qavsdagi so‘z bilan tuzating. Urg‘uni faqat yangi ma’lumotga qo‘ying.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: no, I live in BUkhara, urg‘u Buxoro so‘zining birinchi bo‘g‘inida, live va in kuchsiz. Ikkinchi: no, a WHITE coffee, coffee takrorlangan, shuning uchun urg‘usiz. Uchinchi: no, MAlika wrote it. Bu yerda report o‘rniga it ishlatdik, chunki ma’lum narsa olmosh bilan almashadi. Bu ham tabiiy nutq belgisi.
scenes.say: No, I live in Bukhara. No, a white coffee. No, Malika wrote it.
scenes.say_uz: Yo‘q, men Buxoroda yashayman. Yo‘q, sutli qahva. Yo‘q, uni Malika yozgan.

scenes.title: Tinglash: yig‘ilish rejasi
board: Tuesday or Thursday? · Mark or Maria?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Ikki hamkasb kelasi yig‘ilishni aniqlashtirmoqda. Birinchisi ko‘p narsani noto‘g‘ri eslaydi, ikkinchisi esa uni urg‘u bilan tuzatadi. Har bir tuzatishda qaysi so‘z urg‘uli ekanini kuzating va to‘g‘ri ma’lumotni yozib oling. Raqamli va nomli ma’lumotlarga alohida e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Tom: So the meeting's on Tuesday at ten? Anna: No, it's on Thursday at ten. Tom: Right. And Mark's presenting? Anna: No, Maria's presenting. Mark's taking the notes. Tom: In Room Three? Anna: Room Five. Room Three's being painted. Tom: I'd better write this down, hadn't I?
scenes.say_uz: Tom: Demak yig‘ilish seshanba soat o‘nda? Anna: Yo‘q, payshanba soat o‘nda. Tom: Xo‘p. Mark taqdimot qiladimi? Anna: Yo‘q, Mariya taqdimot qiladi. Mark qaydlarni yozadi. Tom: Uchinchi xonadami? Anna: Beshinchi xonada. Uchinchi xona bo‘yalyapti. Tom: Buni yozib olganim ma’qul, shundaymi?

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 2) Who is presenting, and what is Mark doing?
3) Which room, and why not Room Three?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: yig‘ilish qachon? Ikkinchi: kim taqdimot qiladi va Mark nima qiladi? Uchinchi: qaysi xonada va nega uchinchi xonada emas? Javob berayotganda o‘zingiz ham urg‘uni to‘g‘ri, yangi ma’lumotga qo‘yishga harakat qiling. Tomning oxirgi savolidagi tagga ham quloq soling.
scenes.say: One. When is the meeting? Two. Who is presenting, and what is Mark doing? Three. Which room, and why?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Yig‘ilish qachon? Ikki. Kim taqdimot qiladi, Mark nima qiladi? Uch. Qaysi xonada va nega?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) MAria; Mark is taking the notes
3) Room FIVE; Room Three is being painted
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: payshanba soat o‘nda. Anna faqat Thursday ga urg‘u berdi, at ten esa kuchsiz, chunki vaqt to‘g‘ri edi. Ikkinchi: Maria taqdimot qiladi, Mark qaydlarni yozadi. Uchinchi: beshinchi xonada, chunki uchinchisi bo‘yalyapti. Tomning oxirgi gapi, hadn’t I, tushuvchi tag bilan aytiladi: u javobni biladi.
scenes.say: The meeting is on Thursday at ten. Maria is presenting, and Mark is taking the notes. It's in Room Five, because Room Three is being painted.
scenes.say_uz: Yig‘ilish payshanba soat o‘nda. Mariya taqdimot qiladi, Mark qayd yozadi. U beshinchi xonada, chunki uchinchi xona bo‘yalyapti.

scenes.title: Uchinchi nuqta: ohang aniqligi
board: Tone languages (e.g. Chinese): pitch changes the WORD
English: pitch changes the MESSAGE, not the word
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: ohang aniqligi. Xitoy tili kabi tonal tillarda ovoz balandligi so‘zning lug‘aviy ma’nosini o‘zgartiradi. Ingliz tili tonal til emas: ohang so‘zni o‘zgartirmaydi, lekin xabarni, ya’ni sizning niyatingizni o‘zgartiradi. Shuning uchun inglizchada aniqlik ikki narsa: to‘g‘ri ohangni tanlash va uni to‘g‘ri bo‘g‘indan boshlash. Bittasi xato bo‘lsa, ma’no buziladi.
scenes.say: In English, a change of pitch does not change the dictionary meaning of a word. It changes what you mean by it.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilida ovoz balandligining o‘zgarishi so‘zning lug‘aviy ma’nosini o‘zgartirmaydi. U sizning niyatingizni o‘zgartiradi.

scenes.title: Ohang qayerdan boshlanadi
board: The movement starts on the stressed syllable
and continues over the rest: fanTAS-tic
scenes.say_native: Ohang so‘zning boshidan emas, uning urg‘uli bo‘g‘inidan boshlanadi. Fantastic so‘zida urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: fan-TAS-tic. Ovoz TAS da ko‘tarilib tushadi, tic esa past qoladi. Unbelievable da harakat LIEV bo‘g‘inida, exactly da XACT bo‘g‘inida. Agar ohangni noto‘g‘ri bo‘g‘indan boshlasangiz, so‘zning o‘zi ham tanilmasligi mumkin. Shuning uchun avval so‘z urg‘usini aniq biling.
scenes.say: That's fantastic! Honestly, it's unbelievable. Exactly.
scenes.say_uz: Bu ajoyib! Rostini aytsam, aql bovar qilmaydi. Aynan.

scenes.title: Ro‘yxat va tanlov savollari
board: Choice: Tea ↗ or coffee ↘? (one of the two)
Offer: Tea or coffee ↗? (anything to drink?)

examples.t: Would you like tea or coffee?

scenes.say_native: Ohang aniqligi ro‘yxat va tanlovda ham muhim. Ro‘yxatda har bir bo‘lak ko‘tariladi, oxirgisi esa tushadi: bu tinglovchiga ro‘yxat tugaganini bildiradi. Would you like tea or coffee savolida tea ko‘tarilib, coffee tushsa, ikkisidan birini tanlang degani. Butun savol oxirida ko‘tarilsa, umuman biror ichimlik xohlaysizmi degan ochiq taklif bo‘ladi, javob no, thanks ham bo‘lishi mumkin.
scenes.say: We need apples, pears and plums. Would you like tea, or coffee? Would you like tea or coffee?
scenes.say_uz: Bizga olma, nok va olxo‘ri kerak. Choy ichasizmi yoki qahvami? Choy-poy, qahva ichasizmi?

scenes.title: Ohang tanlovidagi xatolar
board: ✗ Where do you ↗live? (sounds like 'Say that again?')
✗ Tea ↗ or coffee ↗? when you mean 'choose one'
scenes.say_native: Ikki tipik xato. Birinchisi, wh savollarni doim ko‘tarish. O‘zbek tilida savolni ko‘pincha ko‘tarib so‘raymiz, lekin inglizchada where do you live ko‘tarilsa, u ko‘pincha qayta so‘rash, ya’ni qayerda dedingiz degan ma’noni beradi. Neytral savolda tushiring. Ikkinchisi, ikkita variantdan birini tanlashni so‘raganda oxirini ko‘tarish. Bunda tinglovchi yes deb javob berishi mumkin va savol ma’nosini yo‘qotadi.
scenes.say: Where do you live? Not where do you live, with a rise, unless you're asking someone to repeat it.
scenes.say_uz: Qayerda yashaysiz? Ko‘tariluvchi ohang bilan emas, agar qayta so‘ramayotgan bo‘lsangiz.

scenes.title: Ohangni tanlang
board: 1) We visited Rome, Paris and Madrid.
2) Is it Monday or Tuesday? (one of the two)
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta gapni o‘qing va har bir muhim joyda ohang ko‘tariladimi yoki tushadimi, aniqlang. Birinchisi ro‘yxat. Ikkinchisi yopiq tanlov savoli, javob ikkisidan biri. Uchinchisi oddiy, neytral wh savol. Har birini baland ovozda ayting, keyin namuna bilan solishtiring.
scenes.say: Mark the tones, then read each sentence aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Ohanglarni belgilang, keyin har bir gapni baland ovozda o‘qing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Rome ko‘tariladi, Paris ko‘tariladi, Madrid tushadi, ro‘yxat yopildi. Ikkinchi: Monday ko‘tariladi, Tuesday tushadi, ya’ni faqat ikki variant bor. Uchinchi: what’s your surname, surname ning birinchi bo‘g‘inida tushish. Urg‘u SUR da, shuning uchun ohang ham aynan shu bo‘g‘indan boshlanadi.
scenes.say: We visited Rome, Paris and Madrid. Is it Monday, or Tuesday? What's your surname?
scenes.say_uz: Biz Rim, Parij va Madridga bordik. Dushanbami yoki seshanbami? Familiyangiz nima?

scenes.title: To‘rtinchi nuqta: ifodali o‘qish
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: ifodali o‘qish. Matnni ovoz chiqarib o‘qishdan oldin to‘rt qadamni bajaring. Birinchi: matnni ohang bo‘laklariga bo‘ling, vertikal chiziq bilan. Ikkinchi: har bo‘lakda yadro so‘zning tagiga chizing. Uchinchi: strelka bilan ohangni belgilang. To‘rtinchi: personaj munosabatini aniqlang, keyin o‘qing. Bu aktyorlar va diktorlar ishlatadigan usul.
scenes.say: Divide the text into tone units. Underline the nucleus. Add arrows. Decide the attitude. Then read.
scenes.say_uz: Matnni ohang bo‘laklariga bo‘ling. Yadroning tagiga chizing. Strelkalar qo‘ying. Munosabatni aniqlang. Keyin o‘qing.

scenes.title: Belgilangan matn
board: | I ↘KNEW it | it was ↘↗TOO good to be true |
scenes.say_native: Mana belgilangan matn. Birinchi bo‘lak: I KNEW it, tushuvchi ohang, ishonch va biroz achchiqlik. Ikkinchi: it was too good to be true, fall-rise, aytilmagan lekin yoki afsus bor. Uchinchi: and NOW, qisqa pauza. To‘rtinchi: we’re back where we STARted, aniq tushish, xulosa. Bo‘laklar orasidagi kichik pauzalar matnga ritm beradi va tinglovchiga his-tuyg‘uni sezishga vaqt beradi.
scenes.say: I knew it. It was too good to be true. And now, we're back where we started.
scenes.say_uz: Bilgandim. Bu haqiqat bo‘lish uchun juda yaxshi edi. Endi esa yana boshlang‘ich nuqtadamiz.

scenes.title: Ovoz vositalari
board: Pitch range: wide = enthusiastic · narrow = bored, sad
scenes.say_native: Ohangdan tashqari yana uchta vosita bor. Tezlik: sekin nutq jiddiylik yoki g‘amni, tez nutq hayajonni bildiradi. Ovoz diapazoni: keng diapazon, ya’ni balanddan pastgacha, ishtiyoq va qiziqish belgisi; tor diapazon zerikish yoki qayg‘u. Va pauza: kalit so‘zdan oldin bir lahza to‘xtasangiz, u alohida ajralib turadi. O‘zbek tilida so‘zlashuvchilar ko‘pincha tor diapazonda gapiradi, inglizchada uni ataylab kengaytiring.
scenes.say: I've got some news. We won. We actually won!
scenes.say_uz: Bir yangilik bor. Biz yutdik. Biz chindan yutdik!

scenes.title: Bitta gap, to‘rt munosabat
board: I can't believe you did that.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Doskadagi gapni to‘rt xil munosabatda ayting: jahl, hayrat va qoyil qolish, kulgili deb topish va hafsalasi pir bo‘lish. Har safar tezlik, diapazon, pauza va ohangni o‘zgartiring. Qaysi so‘zga urg‘u berishni ham o‘ylang. So‘zlar bir xil qolsin, faqat ovozingiz o‘zgarsin.
scenes.say: Say this sentence four times: angry, impressed, amused and disappointed. I can't believe you did that.
scenes.say_uz: Bu gapni to‘rt marta ayting: jahl bilan, qoyil qolib, kulib va hafsalasi pir bo‘lib. Buni qilganingizga ishonmayman.

scenes.title: Namunaviy talqin
board: A) angry: slow, loud, strong falls on CAN'T and THAT
B) impressed: wide range, rise-fall on THAT
C) amused: lighter, faster, laughing · D) disappointed: low, narrow, slow fall
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy talqin. Jahl: sekin, baland, can’t va that so‘zlarida kuchli tushish, so‘zlar orasida qisqa pauzalar. Qoyil qolish: keng diapazon, that da ko‘tarilib-tushuvchi ohang. Kulgi: yengil, tezroq, kulgi aralash ovoz. Hafsalasi pir: past ovoz, tor diapazon, sekin va cho‘ziq tushish, ko‘pincha urg‘u believe ga tushadi. Sizning variantingiz biroz boshqacha bo‘lishi tabiiy.
scenes.say: I can't believe you did that! I can't believe you did that. I can't believe you did that.
scenes.say_uz: Buni qilganingizga ishonmayman! Bir gapning turli talqinlari.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: dialogni o‘qing
board: A: I've been offered the job in London.
B: London? That's wonderful. When do you leave?
A: Next month. B: Next month… well, we'll miss you.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Doskadagi qisqa dialogni o‘qing. Avval belgilang: ohang bo‘laklari, yadro va strelkalar. B personaj avval hayratda, keyin chindan xursand, oxirida esa biroz g‘amgin. Bu uch munosabatni ovozingiz bilan aniq ko‘rsating. Dialogni ikki marta, avval A, keyin B rolida o‘qing.
scenes.say: Mark the dialogue, then read it aloud. Speaker B moves from surprise to real pleasure, and then to sadness.
scenes.say_uz: Dialogni belgilang, keyin baland ovozda o‘qing. B avval hayratlanadi, keyin chin dildan xursand bo‘ladi, so‘ng xafa bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Namuna va tekshiruv
scenes.say_native: Namuna. London ko‘tariluvchi ohangda, hayrat. That’s wonderful ko‘tarilib-tushuvchi ohangda, chin dildan zavq. When do you leave oddiy wh savol, tushish. Next month fall-rise bilan, ichida aytilmagan afsus bor, keyin well dan so‘ng pauza va we’ll MISS you past, sekin tushish bilan. O‘zingizni tekshiring: uchta munosabat eshitildimi?
scenes.say: A: I've been offered the job in London. B: London? That's wonderful! When do you leave? A: Next month. B: Next month... Well, we'll miss you.
scenes.say_uz: A: Menga Londondagi ishni taklif qilishdi. B: Londonda? Bu ajoyib! Qachon ketasan? A: Kelasi oy. B: Kelasi oy... Xo‘sh, seni sog‘inamiz.

scenes.title: Qisqa takrorlash
scenes.say_native: Takrorlaymiz. Birinchi: tushuvchi ohang ishonch va tugallanganlik, ko‘tariluvchi ochiq savol, fall-rise aytilmagan lekin, rise-fall kuchli his. Taglarda: bilsangiz tushiring, bilmasangiz ko‘taring. Ikkinchi: qarama-qarshi urg‘u yangi ma’lumotga tushadi, takrorlangan so‘z kuchsizlanadi. Uchinchi: to‘g‘ri ohang va to‘g‘ri bo‘g‘in. To‘rtinchi: ifodali o‘qish uchun bo‘lak, yadro, strelka va munosabat.
scenes.say: To recap: choose your tone, stress the new information, start the movement on the right syllable, and plan before you read.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: ohangni tanlang, yangi ma’lumotga urg‘u bering, harakatni to‘g‘ri bo‘g‘indan boshlang va o‘qishdan oldin rejalashtiring.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: read a dialogue with 4 different attitudes
Mark tone units, nuclei and arrows first
Record it: can a listener name all 4 attitudes?
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: kamida sakkiz qatorli dialog tanlang yoki o‘zingiz yozing va uni to‘rt xil munosabatda, masalan hayrat, ikkilanish, kinoya va chin dildan xursandlik bilan o‘qib, ovozingizni yozib oling. Avval matnni belgilang. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: yozuvni eshitgan odam to‘rt munosabatning hammasini to‘g‘ri aniqlaydi. Keyingi darsda eng ko‘p uchraydigan C1 xatolarini tahlil qilamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, record a dialogue read with four different attitudes. Next time, we'll tackle the most common mistakes at this level.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: dialogni to‘rt xil munosabatda o‘qib, yozib oling. Keyingi safar bu darajadagi eng ko‘p uchraydigan xatolarni ko‘rib chiqamiz.

homework_uz: Kamida 8 qatorli dialog tanlang yoki o‘zingiz yozing va uni to‘rt xil munosabatda (masalan, hayrat, ikkilanish, kinoya, chin dildan xursandlik) o‘qib, audioga yozib oling. Avval ohang bo‘laklari, yadro va strelkalarni belgilang. Mezon: yozuvni tinglagan odam to‘rt munosabatning hammasini to‘g‘ri aniqlay oladi.

quiz.q: Which tone usually expresses certainty and finality?
quiz.why_uz: Tushuvchi ohang ishonch va tugallanganlikni bildiradi.

quiz.q: 'Sorry?' with a rising tone usually means…
quiz.why_uz: Ko‘tariluvchi sorry qayta so‘rash; tushuvchi sorry uzr.

quiz.q: 'The food was good…' said with a fall-rise suggests…
options: The speaker is asking a question.

quiz.q: 'It's a lovely day, isn't it?' with a falling tag means the speaker…
quiz.why_uz: Tushuvchi tag: javob ma’lum, faqat rozilik kutiladi.

quiz.q: A: 'Did you buy the red shirt?' B: 'No, I bought the ___ shirt.' Where is the main stress?
quiz.why_uz: Yangi ma’lumot blue ga urg‘u; takrorlangan shirt kuchsiz.

options: I took something else of yours.
quiz.why_uz: YOUR ga urg‘u: sizniki emas, boshqa odamnikini oldim.

quiz.q: 'Would you like tea ↗ or coffee ↘?' means…
options: Do you want any drink at all?
I'm not sure what we have.
quiz.why_uz: Oxiri tushsa, yopiq tanlov: ikkisidan biri.

quiz.q: In English, a change of pitch on a word usually changes…
quiz.why_uz: Ingliz tili tonal emas: ohang so‘zni emas, niyatni o‘zgartiradi.

quiz.q: Where does the tone movement start in 'fantastic'?
Which sounds most bored or unfriendly?
options: 'Thank you' with a high start and a clear fall
'Thank you so much!' with a wide range
quiz.why_uz: Past va tekis ohang zerikish yoki norozilikni bildiradi.
